objective: Evidence-grounded motivation + expectation graph. Fix V3.5 root cause: motivation_insufficient=85%, expectation_insufficient=90%. Build edge-based evidence graph (not free-form 'motivation=yes'). Use better NVIDIA models (gemma-4-31b-it, deepseek-v4-flash).

v3_5_frozen_results.root_cause: LLM too conservative in finding motivation/expectation evidence. 85% of cases get MOTIVATION_INSUFFICIENT, 90% get EXPECTATION_INSUFFICIENT. This is an evidence retrieval issue, not a prompt aggression issue.

v3_6_changes_from_v3_5: BETTER MODELS: use google/gemma-4-31b-it (31B params, better legal reasoning) + deepseek-v4-flash as fallback
MOTIVATION EVIDENCE GRAPH: edge-based, not free-form. Each edge: source_id + exact_span + date_valid + evidence_type + strength + reason. No 'motivation=yes' without supporting edges.

12 MOTIVATION EVIDENCE TYPES: REFERENCE_TEACHING / KNOWN_PROBLEM / DESIGN_INCENTIVE / MARKET_FORCE / PREDICTABLE_SUBSTITUTION / COMPATIBILITY_SAME_FUNCTION / COMMON_GENERAL_KNOWLEDGE / EXPLICIT_REFERENCE_CROSS_LINK / KNOWN_TRADEOFF / PERFORMANCE_IMPROVEMENT / COST_SIZE_SPEED_SAFETY_INCENTIVE / REGULATORY_ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINT

10 MOTIVATION SEARCH FAMILIES: M1=same_problem / M2=same_disadvantage / M3=same_desired_improvement / M4=same_component_improved_property / M5=known_substitution / M6=same_CPC_IPC_same_technical_effect / M7=citation_linked_combination / M8=explicit_cross_reference / M9=assignee_competitor_implementation / M10=market_manufacturing_regulatory_pressure

EXPECTATION EVIDENCE GRAPH: separate from motivation. modification -> mechanism_compatibility -> predicted_result -> evidence_result_reasonably_expected. Each edge: source + passage + date + confidence.

EXPECTATION EVIDENCE TYPES: known_compatible_mechanism / same_operating_regime / established_substitution / predictable_engineering_result / reference_explicitly_reporting_result / common_general_knowledge / demonstrated_compatibility / same_function_same_field
DO NOT TURN INSUFFICIENT INTO OBVIOUS: MOTIVATION_INSUFFICIENT -> not OBVIOUS. EXPECTATION_INSUFFICIENT -> not OBVIOUS. 103=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless independent evidence closes the missing edge.

COMBINATION COMPATIBILITY TEST: before combining A+B, test technical_compatibility + operating_regime_compatibility + material_compatibility + functional_compatibility + architecture_compatibility. EPO: combining may not be obvious where essential features are inherently incompatible.
PRE-FILING DATE FIREWALL: every motivation/expectation evidence item must pass publication_date < relevant_date or be valid common-general-knowledge evidence at that time.
OBJECTIVE TECHNICAL PROBLEM: construct from closest_prior_art + distinguishing_features + technical_effect. Independently check for contamination by knowledge of claimed invention.
3-CANDIDATE CLOSEST PRIOR ART: score by purpose/technical_field/technical_effect/structural_similarity/functional_similarity. Choose best-supported closest reference.

PROSECUTION-GROUND-TRUTH COMPARISON: for each false-negative 103 case, compare examiner motivation vs system motivation graph, examiner expectation vs system expectation graph. Classify missing evidence: SEARCH / INTERPRETATION / MAPPING / MOTIVATION / EXPECTATION / ADJUDICATION.
NEW METRICS: motivation_evidence_recall / expectation_evidence_recall / motivation_graph_completeness / expectation_graph_completeness
stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3.6 reaches 103>=80% AND motivation_evidence_recall>=80% AND expectation_evidence_recall>=80%.
